name: Segawa Kaede
source:
Kaede behaves like a strict honor student for the most part, but she also truly possesses a sadistic side. Recently, teasing [url=/c98231]Asuka[/url] has become a hobby of hers. She is part of the Disciplinary Committee, but it's purely because she gets joy from making the other students distraught when she gives them citations. Kaede and [url=/c98570]Sakura[/url] are good friends and are often seen together. They're referred to as the Springfall Duo by the other students. Being Sakura's friend, Kaede also abides by [url=/c98214]Reika[/url], just like she does.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
